title: Is Grokipedia Right-Leaning? Comparing Political Framing in Wikipedia and Grokipedia on Controversial Topics
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating political leaning and ideological framing (left-leaning vs. right-leaning) using a political stance classifier. While the controversial topics analyzed (such as abortion) often intersect with moral and religious views, the study's objective and methodology are centered on political bias and information science (epistemic authority) rather than evaluating religion, theology, or ethical frameworks.
